---
description: "Use when: editing Markdown structure, formatting, headings, lists, or validation"
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Markdown

## Format

- Prefer clear sections and lists over tables when they are easier to edit.
- Use bullets for naturally list-shaped content; do not split prose into bullets just to reduce editor line length.
- Keep prose fluid; do not hard-wrap lines. Separate paragraphs with blank lines.
- Keep headings short and clear. Use emojis when they help.

## Validation

When changing markdown files, run markdown linting or the repo's markdown formatter before handover so documentation changes do not introduce markdownlint errors.
